_about: Ranfurlie tank-mix product library. One record per product, read off the current AU label / maker SDS. {amt} in 'how' is replaced with the tank amount. 'why' is the default reason for its place in the order; a recipe can override it. PPE keys: overalls, hat, gloves, goggles, shield, mask, apron, boots. Checked 14-15 Oct 2026.

companion.name: Companion
companion.what: Acidifying and penetrating surfactant (soya phospholipids + propionic acid)
companion.hazFull: Will damage eyes. Will irritate the skin. Avoid contact with eyes and skin. Label: DO NOT use with copper products.
companion.why: The label says Companion goes in first, before the other products. It holds the tank pH down for the ethephon.

chlorostick.name: Chlorostick 720 SC
chlorostick.haz: Attacks eyes and skin. Don't breathe the mist.
chlorostick.hazFull: Attacks eyes and skin. Don't inhale spray mist. Repeated exposure may cause allergies. If clothing gets product or spray on it, take it off straight away. Label: DO NOT mix spraying oils or wetting agents with this product.
how: Shake and turn each drum over
Rinse each drum 3 times into the tank
chlorostick.why: A suspension goes in early so it spreads through plenty of moving water.
chlorostick.src: Label APVMA 69652 · SDS Feb 2025 · label · SDS

shadow.name: Shadow Ultra
shadow.hazFull: Harmful if inhaled (SDS). Avoid contact with eyes and skin. Don't breathe spray mist. No rain or irrigation within 1 h of spraying. No entry without protective clothing until the spray has dried.
how: Rinse the jug into the tank
shadow.why: The label says add it to a tank at least two-thirds full of water. You're at {before} L.

promote.name: Promote Plus 900
promote.hazFull: Corrosive (SDS: causes severe skin burns and eye damage). Splash in the eye: flush with water for at least 15 minutes and get medical help. Don't use alkaline water. Don't let the mix stand in metal for more than 2 hours. No rain expected within 8 hours.
how: Pour slowly, low to the opening
Rinse the jug and drums into the tank
promote.why: Goes in after Companion so it lands in acidified water. The label says don't use alkaline water.
promote.src: Label APVMA 69487 · SDS ADAMA Jun 2023 · label · SDS

astron.name: ASTRON
astron.what: Floratine foliar biostimulant (Ca, Mg, Fe, Zn, Cu, B)
astron.hazFull: SDS signal word DANGER: causes serious eye damage, causes skin irritation. Contains a copper salt (0.15% Cu). Chemical goggles and impervious gloves.
astron.why: Floratine's mixing order is ASTRON, then Perk Up, then GlycoFuze. It's high in solids, so the strainer comes out.
astron.src: Floratine info sheet + SDS Apr 2024 · SDS

perkup.name: Perk Up
perkup.hazFull: SDS signal word DANGER: causes serious eye damage. Chemical goggles; impervious gloves for long contact.
perkup.why: Floratine's order puts Perk Up before GlycoFuze.
perkup.src: Floratine info sheet + SDS Apr 2024 · SDS

glyco.name: GlycoFuze 2-1-2
glyco.hazFull: Not classified as hazardous (SDS). Goggles and gloves if handling for long.
glyco.why: Last of the Floratine products, by their order.
glyco.src: Floratine info sheet + SDS Apr 2024 · SDS

iron.name: Grass Roots Iron
iron.what: Oasis Turf liquid iron, 6% Fe, pH about 2
iron.hazFull: SDS signal word WARNING: eye irritation. Safety glasses, PVC gloves, overalls, apron and safety boots; eyewash nearby. Label rate 10-20 L/ha.
iron.why: Big volume and no mixing restrictions on its label, so it goes in late.
iron.src: Label + SDS May 2025 (Oasis Turf) · label · SDS

prokelp.name: Pro Kelp
prokelp.what: Grass Roots Pro Kelp 25: Tasmanian bull kelp extracted with caustic potash, pH 10-12.5
prokelp.haz: Strongly alkaline. Keep it apart from the iron and GreenMaxx neat.
prokelp.hazFull: Not classified as hazardous (SDS Nov 2025). pH above 10, contains potassium hydroxide under 5%. Impervious gloves, safety glasses with side shields, cotton overalls; apron for large volumes. Label: 20-50 L/ha in 700 L water/ha; check compatibility before tank mixing.
how: Rinse the drums into the tank
prokelp.why: It's strongly alkaline. Going in early, into plain water, means it never meets the acidic products neat.
prokelp.src: Oasis Turf label + SDS Nov 2025 · label · SDS

greenmaxx.name: GreenMaxx 20-0-0
greenmaxx.what: LiquiMaxx GreenMaxx: stabilised urea N 20%, with 6% Fe and 1% Mg as sulphates, pH 2-3
greenmaxx.hazFull: SDS signal word WARNING: harmful if swallowed, skin and eye irritant, may irritate airways. PVC gloves, overalls and apron, safety glasses or goggles; eyewash nearby. Strong bases listed as incompatible. May settle in the IBC, so stir before drawing. Label rate 20-50 L/ha.
greenmaxx.why: Acidic, like the iron. Goes in late with the other fertiliser.
greenmaxx.src: SDS Dec 2024 (Indigo / Greenway) · SDS · brochure
